subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Organizar ideias, selecionando-as em função da estrutura e do objetivo do texto.

components.description_pt: Identificar a estrutura e propósito de um tipo de texto dado
components.description_en: Identify the structure and purpose of a given text type
components.cc_component_description: Identify common characteristics of a literary text type such as a poem or storybook

components.description_pt: Selecionar ideias relevantes à estrutura e propósito do texto sendo produzido
components.description_en: Select ideas relevant to the structure and purpose of the text being produced
components.cc_component_description: Select well-chosen facts, details, or quotations relevant to the topic being developed

components.description_pt: Organizar escrita de forma que desenvolvimento e estrutura sejam apropriados à tarefa e propósito
components.description_en: Organize writing so that development and structure are appropriate to the task and purpose
components.cc_component_description: Organize writing so that development and structure are appropriate to the task and purpose

cc_matches.description: Produce clear and coherent writing in which the development, organization, and style are appropriate to task, purpose, and audience.
Recognize common types of texts (e.g., storybooks, poems).

Develop the topic with well-chosen, relevant, and sufficient facts, extended definitions, concrete details, quotations, or other information and examples appropriate to the audience's knowledge of the topic.
